channel.title: Unlock Pulse
channel.description: Token unlocks sized against circulating supply: monthly numbers, weekly calendars and deep dives.

item.title: The rule said 78 in 100. Since I started writing it down, it is 8 of 22.
item.description: Three weeks of a public journal of strong token unlocks: 8 of 22 went the way the archive suggests. What Bitcoin's 15% fall has to do with it, and why the misses stay on the page.

item.title: The cliff moved six months. My calendar did not notice.
item.description: On November 10 Allora postponed the unlock of 485.5 million ALLO held by its team and backers to May 2027. Six days later my own calendar still listed a strong ALLO unlock for December 10. What changed, and what is really left for December.

item.title: Ten ideas about token unlocks that did not survive testing
item.description: Recipient type, trading volume, post-unlock bounce, exchange inflows, funding skew and more: ten plausible ideas tested on 304 unlocks, and why only one rule about size remained.

item.title: MBG has no unlock on November 22. It vests every second.
item.description: Calendars list an MBG unlock on November 22. The vesting contract releases tokens every second, and holders collect quarterly. My own card was wrong too.

item.title: PYTH fell before its unlock, not after it
item.description: In May 2026 Pyth unlocked 2.1 billion PYTH, 37% of the supply then trading. The coin lost 24% in the week before. Six months of what followed, against Bitcoin.

item.title: Token unlocks in December 2026: data for journalists
item.description: 162 token unlocks in December 2026, 40 strong. Biggest vs circulating supply and by value, who receives them, how prices moved before past unlocks. Free to quote.

item.title: KAITO unlocks 17.6 million tokens every month. Is that 7% of supply, or 3.5%?
item.description: Kaito releases about 1.76% of its supply on the 19th–20th of each month, more than half of it to the team and investors. Size depends on which circulating figure you use. What 16 past payouts did to the price.

item.title: JCT and TA unlock in November, says the calendar. The project documents give other dates
item.description: Aggregator calendars put Janction (JCT) on November 10 and Trusta.AI (TA) on November 15. Read against the projects' own documents, the dates move to December 10 and November 21. What we checked and what to watch.

item.title: QAIT unlocks 462.5 million tokens on October 31. Is that 92% of supply, or 7%?
item.description: One unlock, four sizes: QAIT's October 31 cliff is 92%, 46%, 24% or 7.5% of circulating supply depending on whose figure you trust. What the data says and what to watch.
